en: ancient men and boys building new stone houses in a village, no text (They built new cities)

en: ancient merchants with baskets and donkeys at a market, no text (A people of merchants only)

en: a line of strong ancient soldiers in armor marching, no text (A strong and mighty people)

en: foreign onlookers watching in amazement as a long line of ancient men and boys walks home over green hills singing, no text (That the Lord is with them)

caption: לשלח אותם למדבר
en: a group of ancient men walking into a vast dry desert with rocky cliffs, no text (To send them to the desert)
